_comment: The stock firmware builds Kraken is built for (docs/firmware-builds.md). Everything in this repo - sources, hooks.json,
menu_hosts.json, the manifests, the tests - is written against the REFERENCE build. Every other build gets Kraken through
tools/fwmap.py: a checked map from each reference address to the same code or data in that build (firmware/<id>/addrmap.json,
generated; firmware/<id>/overrides.json, reviewed by hand), applied by tools/fw_translate.py to copies under out/.
No firmware is committed. The reference image comes from dm32uv-re; the others are Baofeng update files fetched by
tools/fetch_stock.py from the commit-pinned URL below and checked against update_sha256. A 1 MiB base image is the
reference image's boot region (0x03000000-0x0300BFFF: boot header, Baofeng's loader, the blanked per-unit sector; the
updater never writes it) with the update file's body from 0x0300C000 and 0xFF after it.
version_at: where the build keeps its version string (Menu > Device Info shows it); the installers check it there.
radio_tested: Kraken has been installed and used on a real radio on this build. The web installer shows an
untested-build warning, which the person must accept, before it flashes Kraken onto a build without it.

firmwares.source: a radio read (dm32uv-re PROVENANCE.md); Baofeng never published this build
Baofeng's public download, archived by M7OCM (branch DM-32UV-Firmware-(most-common)); the reference build without the voice recorder
Baofeng firmware archived by M7OCM (branch DM-32UV-Firmware-(most-common)); shipped on radios sold from late 2025
